detailed_description: CSS Triangle Generator builds a triangle snippet that uses the classic CSS border trick - a zero-size box with one solid border edge and transparent neighbors. Pick one of eight direction buttons (up, down, left, right, up-left, up-right, down-left, down-right), drag the width and height sliders between 20 and 200 pixels, and pick a color. The preview updates live and the output panel shows the matching width, height, and border CSS, with a Copy button to send it to the clipboard. The tool does not output SVG, support borders/strokes, generate equilateral triangles, or export image files.
usage_steps: Click one of the eight direction buttons (cardinal or diagonal)
Drag the width slider between 20 and 200 pixels
Drag the height slider between 20 and 200 pixels
Pick a color with the color picker
Click Copy to copy the generated CSS snippet
usage_examples: Generate a small downward-pointing triangle for a tooltip arrow
Build a leftward triangle to use as a back-button decoration
Pick a diagonal triangle to make a corner ribbon shape
Adjust width and height to make a thin breadcrumb separator
